status.title: Modded Server On Hold
status.message: Modded Server has been placed in an offline state for the time being. Depending on player interest, this may be indefinite.

status.title: CrashCraft Network Core
status.message: The CrashCraft Network will remain offline for the time being. I am working on a LTS configuration on very lightweight hardware as to not waste power on running empty servers for months using the legacy configuration. Thank you for understanding!
